name: Ash
title: Ashwake Vendetta
quote: I buried my family. I did not bury the debt.
effect: +15 percentage points to hit chance and +10% direct damage against pirates.
motif: a black phoenix rising from grey ashes, crossed spent cartridges, muted ember orange accents

name: Bulk
title: Extra Ballistic Protection
quote: It's not extra weight. It's extra ballistic protection.
effect: +10% squad member hit points. With a machine gun equipped, incoming suppression is reduced by 15%.
motif: a heavy steel breastplate above a belt of machine gun cartridges, gunmetal silver and muted brass

name: Caleb
title: Hold the Line
quote: The readiness is all.
effect: While in cover and before moving this turn: +10 percentage points to primary weapon hit chance and 20% less incoming suppression.
motif: a reinforced defensive wall, upright infantry rifle and three orderly chevrons, olive and ivory

name: Camila
title: Contract Kill
quote: One round. One invoice.
effect: The first sniper attack each turn gains +10 percentage points to hit chance and +15% direct damage. A miss also spends the bonus; movement does not.
motif: a single long sniper cartridge over a rolled sealed contract, small scoped rifle silhouette, burgundy and brass

name: Creed
title: Old Drill
quote: This uniform has outlived better men than you.
effect: +10 discipline. The first primary weapon attack each turn costs 10% fewer action points.
motif: a vintage marine helmet, crossed service rifles and weathered service chevrons, khaki and antique gold

name: Crow
title: Frontier Watch
quote: Out here, the horizon is the only warning you get.
effect: +1 vision range. Deploying the squad costs 10% fewer supplies.
motif: a raven perched on a frontier watchtower above desert ridges, slate blue and sand

name: Darius
title: First Through the Breach
quote: Once more unto the breach, dear friends, once more.
effect: The first attack each turn, if its target is within 3 tiles, deals +20% direct damage and +25% suppression.
motif: a steel boarding axe smashing a breached hatch, red banner ribbon without text and shell casings, crimson and steel

name: Don
title: Protective Detail
quote: The client goes home. That's the job.
effect: Other friendly infantry squads within 2 tiles take 10% less direct damage. Don does not receive his own protection; identical auras do not stack.
motif: a broad shield protecting two smaller infantry silhouettes with an alert eye crest, navy and pale grey

name: Lucky
title: Long Haul
quote: Bad road. Good driver. We'll get there.
effect: Vehicle movement through costly terrain uses 20% fewer action points, never less than the normal terrain cost.
motif: a heavy truck steering wheel framing a winding rough road and small four leaf clover, dusty amber and green

name: Luo
title: By the Book
quote: Orders first. Opinions later.
effect: While another friendly infantry squad is within 3 tiles: +10 discipline and +5 percentage points to primary weapon hit chance.
motif: an open field manual beneath an orderly formation of three rifle chevrons, dark green and ivory

name: Lynx
title: Silent Observer
quote: The less they see, the more I know.
effect: +1 camouflage and +1 detection range. Attacks from concealment gain +10 percentage points to hit chance.
motif: a watchful lynx head with luminous amber eyes above a concealed dagger and fern leaves, charcoal and olive

name: Marcus
title: Room Service
quote: Knock once. Clear twice.
effect: Primary weapon attacks within 3 tiles gain +10 percentage points to hit chance and cost 10% fewer action points.
motif: a breached doorway and compact rifle angled forward with a small brass room bell, black steel and gold

name: Markov
title: Measured Bursts
quote: Short bursts. Long day.
effect: Machine guns deal +50% suppression. Before moving this turn, machine gun attacks gain +10 percentage points to hit chance.
motif: a machine gun barrel above three evenly spaced cartridge clusters, olive and dull copper

name: Null
title: Settle the Account
quote: Nothing will come of nothing.
effect: Deal +15% direct damage to targets below 50% hit points. The first kill each turn refunds 20 action points.
motif: a pale featureless skull over a closed ledger pierced by a dagger, ivory and black with a tiny red wax seal

name: Rook
title: Combat Driver
quote: Cargo doesn't care who's shooting.
effect: Vehicle turns and reversing cost 25% fewer action points. The first shot after a turn this turn gains +10 percentage points to hit chance.
motif: an armored transport front and steering wheel inside a protective chess rook tower silhouette, dark blue and silver

name: Sigrid
title: Still Breathing
quote: If you can complain, you can survive.
effect: Retains First Aid healing for own squad and friendly squad leaders, including its normal use limits. Costs 25% fewer action points. The treated unit takes 20% less suppression until the end of its next turn.
motif: a silver Norse knot shield with a green medical cross and heartbeat line, evergreen and ivory, no red cross

name: Talia
title: My Way
quote: I have my own way of following orders.
effect: After the first attack each turn, the next 2 movement tiles cost 25% fewer action points. Unused movement expires at the end of the turn.
motif: a crooked arrow breaking free from three straight arrows, cracked regulation chevron and tiny grinning mask, teal and brass

name: Track
title: Steel Routine
quote: Steel remembers what men forget.
effect: Before moving this turn, vehicle guns gain +10 percentage points to hit chance and +15% armor penetration.
motif: a tank gun barrel framed by a circular tracked tread with a rigid cog, gunmetal and muted yellow

name: Vale
title: Live to Walk Away
quote: The better part of valour is discretion.
effect: After taking direct damage, the next 2 movement tiles cost 25% fewer action points, through the end of the next own turn. Further hits refresh this benefit without stacking.
motif: a lone boot print leaving a cracked pirate skull behind on dusty dunes, sand and charcoal

name: Viper
title: Cobra's Step
quote: Precision is not patience. Precision is control.
effect: Walkers spend 2 fewer action points per movement tile. The first attack after moving each turn gains +10 percentage points to hit chance.
motif: a golden cobra coiled around a mechanical walker leg with angular motion marks, dark emerald and gold

name: Voss
title: Let It Burn
quote: Hell is empty, and all the devils are here.
effect: Infantry flamethrower attacks deal +20% direct damage and +25% suppression. Does not alter damage from fire left on the ground.
motif: a stylized flamethrower nozzle breathing orange flames around a grinning skull, black charcoal and burnt orange
